answer: Rhythm-Gated Admission Lanes.** Each identity must emit a stable arrival cadence; agents admitting a newcomer sample its inter-arrival timing and require it to fall inside a live island of accepted traces. A burst of near-simultaneous creations trips a raven flag: the batch is quarantined until its members sustain distinct, low-variance rhythms for several epochs. Saffron tokens are paid per quarantined identity per epoch to keep the lane open. Attackers pay continuous holding cost per fake identity plus lost parallelism, since synchronized mass registration self-identifies and stalls.
